savedState.compatibility: Optional version-one field; sparse existing backups still load.
savedState.budget: Five or ten minutes, pinned when the run starts.
savedState.sequence: Gist check, detail check for ten-minute runs, changed-detail retelling, completion. Any first-check result permits continuing; correctness is not a completion gate.
savedState.firstEvidence: The selected choice, correctness, support flag and first-check date are immutable. Draft selections persist before checking. Transcript/model exposure persists and supports later first checks; later support does not rewrite earlier evidence.
savedState.production: Learner-written notes and two explicit self-checks; editing resets those checks. A completed original response is locked.
savedState.laterTask: Opens from original completion plus one calendar day; separate draft, checks, model-exposure flag and completion date. Completed later responses are locked.
savedState.dates: Valid future calendar dates remain import-compatible for clock/timezone differences; chronological relationships and the exact next-day due date are checked. Future tasks do not become due early.
savedState.capacity: Maximum 200 runs; new starts pause without deleting saved evidence. Existing runs remain editable until completion.

privacyAndTransfer.persisted: Original public portal-scene identity, bounded learner writing, selected choices, support flags, self-checks and dates.
privacyAndTransfer.excluded: Audio bytes, local-file metadata, object URLs, pasted source transcripts, browser/session state and arbitrary unknown fields.
privacyAndTransfer.validation: Exact allowed keys at state/run/check/first/transfer levels, known scene and choice identities, scoring-key agreement, bounded writing, stage order and date consistency.
privacyAndTransfer.backupMerge: Keep each whole local overlapping run; add incoming new runs. An incoming union above 200 refuses the entire merge before applying any additions. Explicit replacement still uses the existing validated restore path.
privacyAndTransfer.noCreditChanges: No XP, daily estimated-minute credit or core daily-plan changes are introduced by model completion or transfer.

accepted: A mismatched or absent run/scene route falls back to the catalogue with a status message.
A direct early return-task URL shows its opening date and no editable production controls.
First-check choice controls become read-only and allow continuing after an incorrect first response.
Completed original and later tasks render saved output without edit controls.
Original and later model exposure use separate state helpers; transcript opening records support before a first check.
Local-file listening remains a separate workspace reached by navigation; its media or transcript is not copied into oral-practice state.

findingAddressedByRoot.problem: The initial English UI rendered only the English sentence frame, hiding its Italian scaffold unless a learner opened the full model.
findingAddressedByRoot.fix: The shared original/transfer production block now always shows the Italian frame with lang=it and adds the English frame when translations are enabled.
findingAddressedByRoot.verification: Source integration inspected after the root fix; final rendered browser QA is assigned to the oral-practice browser audit.

additionalFindingsAddressedByRoot.problem: Feedback focus depended on a first-check object reference. Re-reading stored progress creates a fresh object, so opening transcript support after checking could focus feedback again and pull the reader away from the transcript.
additionalFindingsAddressedByRoot.fix: Focus now depends on stable primitive check-kind, first-check date and choice identity. Support-only updates do not trigger new first-feedback focus.
additionalFindingsAddressedByRoot.verification: Final source dependency list inspected; rendered focus and transcript behavior are included in the separate browser audit.

additionalFindingsAddressedByRoot.problem: The safe refusal of a merge above 200 distinct runs used generic wording about an invalid current record.
additionalFindingsAddressedByRoot.fix: The preview now identifies the 200-distinct-run merge limit and explains that all current work is preserved.
additionalFindingsAddressedByRoot.verification: Final source branch inspected; the existing atomic-capacity test confirms no partial merge or pruning.

nonblockingNotes: A model no-op preserves evidence, but the existing portal save wrapper still refreshes updatedAt. This does not create completion or XP.

validation.focusedTypeScript: passed for model, original scene data, engine and backup merge
coverage: Pinned five/ten-minute flow and advancement after an incorrect first check.
Pending selection reload, support continuity and immutable first evidence.
Production edit resets, completion locks and next-day transfer separation.
Unknown/private-field rejection, bad identities, scoring, dates, order and oversized text.
Version-one backup compatibility, whole-local-run conflict preservation and input immutability.
Two-hundred-run pause without pruning and atomic refusal of an overflowing merge.
Exact agreement between lazy authored choices and compact validation/scoring metadata.
Unchanged core daily plan, estimated minutes and XP.
validation.browserBoundary: This document does not claim rendered browser outcomes for the new oral-practice view; the separate owned browser audit records those after the coordinated final build.

learningEvidenceBoundary: These tests establish state integrity and implementation behavior. A typed choice is a narrow comprehension check; retelling and later tasks are self-assessed. They do not establish independent listening ability, pronunciation accuracy, retention gains or speaking improvement.
